seo.title: Strikingly vs Squarespace — Which Website Builder Is Best for You
seo.meta_description: Compare Strikingly and Squarespace: ease of use, templates, ecommerce, SEO, pricing, and support to decide which website builder converts best for your business

hero.headline: Strikingly vs Squarespace
hero.subheadline: A side-by-side comparison for buyers, operators, and affiliate-content readers.

summary.best_for_a: Strikingly is best for solo creators and small businesses who need a one-page, mobile-first site launched in minutes.
summary.best_for_b: Squarespace is best for designers and growing businesses that want polished templates, stronger ecommerce, and deeper customization.
summary.quick_take: Strikingly gets you online fast with a simple, one-page focus and a gentle learning curve, making it ideal for portfolios, landing pages, and micro sites. Squarespace is more feature-rich: elegant templates, stronger ecommerce tools, and more customization, so it converts better for businesses prioritizing branding and sales.

rows.tool_a: Extremely simple, drag-and-drop one-page editor designed for beginners.
rows.tool_b: Intuitive but richer editor with more controls—takes longer to master.

rows.tool_a: Fewer templates focused on single-page, mobile-first layouts.
rows.tool_b: Large library of high-quality, conversion-optimized templates for many industries.

rows.tool_a: Basic ecommerce suitable for low-volume sales and simple stores.
rows.tool_b: Advanced ecommerce with inventory, subscriptions, and multi-channel selling.

rows.tool_a: Lower entry price and a free plan; add-ons are minimal.
rows.tool_b: Higher starting price but more built-in features and value for businesses.

rows.tool_a: Essential SEO features and simple social sharing tools.
rows.tool_b: Stronger SEO controls, blogging, email campaigns, and marketing integrations.

rows.tool_a: Limited custom code options; designed to keep things simple.
rows.tool_b: Custom CSS/JS and developer platform support for advanced customizations.

rows.tool_a: Responsive support and helpful guides for beginners.
rows.tool_b: 24/7 support and extensive help center plus community resources.

rows.tool_b: Templates are responsive with more control over mobile styling.

rows.tool_a: Minutes to a finished site with templates and quick setup.
rows.tool_b: Hours to days depending on customization and content needs.

paragraphs: Strikingly and Squarespace are popular website builders that make it possible to create a professional site without hiring a developer. They both include hosting, templates, and domain management, but they take very different approaches to design, flexibility, and ecommerce.

Choosing between them comes down to your goals: launch speed and simplicity (Strikingly) versus design quality, template depth, and ecommerce power (Squarespace). Below we compare the key areas that affect conversions: ease of use, templates, ecommerce, SEO, and cost.

data.headline: Squarespace wins for design and commerce; Strikingly wins for speed and simplicity
data.summary: If you want beautiful templates and robust ecommerce, choose Squarespace. If you need to launch quickly with minimal setup and cost, pick Strikingly. Both work well, but your priority—custom look vs instant simplicity—should decide the winner.

pros: Fast setup with one-page templates that convert quickly
Lower starting cost and extremely beginner-friendly editor
cons: Limited template variety and advanced customization
Ecommerce and app ecosystem are basic compared with bigger builders

pros: Beautiful, conversion-optimized templates and strong ecommerce features
Flexible styling, integrations, and developer options for scaling
cons: Steeper learning curve and slightly higher price points
Can be overkill for single-page projects or ultra-simple sites

tool_a: Quick one-page sites that look great on mobile
Built-in analytics and simple site management

Strong SEO tools and third-party integrations

items.question: Which is easier for complete beginners?
items.answer: Strikingly is easier for complete beginners thanks to its one-page focus and simplified editor; Squarespace is beginner-friendly too but offers more options that require a bit more time to learn.

items.question: Can I sell products on both platforms?
items.answer: Yes—both platforms support ecommerce. Strikingly covers simple stores and digital goods, while Squarespace offers a more complete commerce suite with inventory, subscriptions, and shipping features.

items.question: Which builder offers better SEO?
items.answer: Squarespace offers more advanced SEO controls and marketing tools, which can help drive traffic and conversions for growing sites; Strikingly covers essential SEO needs for small sites.

items.question: Is it easy to switch from one to the other?
items.answer: Migration requires manual export/import of content and images; Squarespace has some import tools, but there’s no seamless two-click transfer—plan for a rebuild if you switch.

items.question: Which platform gives the best value for businesses?
items.answer: For small, simple projects Strikingly is cost-effective. For businesses that need branding, ecommerce, and scalability, Squarespace typically provides better long-term value despite higher upfront costs.
